method: driver self-report -- the playtester's OWN driver re-run on this build, its conditional defect/worked branches diffed against the pre-replay backup (coordinate-anchored match)
coordinate probe -- every distinct coordinate quoted in a defect (306 stations) re-driven with real KeyboardEvents: settle 1.6 s, four held-W walks, a jump, a camera read, a frame
mechanism probe -- every live warden, gnasher, breakable, cannon, power hat, race pad, quicksand pool, conveyor, jump/speed pad, seesaw, crest and sigil in all 14 courses, driven
scene/console probe -- console warnings at load, coincident-mesh audit, killY vs lowest geometry, live HUD DOM rectangles
probe5 -- underwater grade, long-jump window sweep, run-up sweep, currents, sinkers, clear card
contract gates -- gatecheck, spawnwalk (all 12 routable gates), loopcheck, camcheck, feelcheck, contrastcheck, reachcheck, modulecheck
replay frames -- read by eye where the complaint is a colour / legibility / 'reads as' claim

drivers.why: Each driver invocation costs 45-190 s of browser time and they must run ONE at a time; 232 of them is ~7 h. The 15 that ran are the azure-1 suite, chosen first because those drivers self-report into _playreports and so answer their own defects mechanically. The remaining 217 were traded for the probe passes and the contract gates, which decide more defects per minute of browser time.
